title: Reconcile phase-1 target and bound mutation consolidation phase 2
objective: Produce a read-only, exact-evidence phase-1 reconciliation and a bounded implementation plan for phase-2 mutation consolidation, accounting for the three protected Lot44 exceptions and the fact that the Lot45 mutation workflow exists only on the suspended candidate head.

required_invariants: phase-1 accounting distinguishes removable fanout from protected Lot44 exceptions
Lot45 mutation workflow is read-only candidate evidence and is not copied into business state
phase-2 plan preserves every mutation target threshold exact-head prerequisite and evidence requirement before consolidation
generic consolidation must not make candidate progress depend on a paid or LLM service
no workflow is changed in this planning AWU
acceptance_criteria: plan records 38 removed historical workflows and 3 protected exceptions
plan identifies P0.6 extended mutation and Lot45 mutation as the two top-level mutation workflows remaining after historical cleanup
plan records institutional code-quality mutation as an overlapping embedded capability for later phase-3 deduplication
plan proposes a reusable profile-driven mutation control without authorizing candidate mutation
next implementation AWU is small enough to build the generic control independently of Lot45

done_when: phase-1 target is reconciled to protected Lot44 reality
phase-2 mutation consolidation boundary is explicit and auditable
no workflow or business code is changed
next implementation AWU can be created without rereading the whole repository
